name: Return to the Hinterlands
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.  The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.

There.  I have done my part.  I bid you fortune on your quest, adventurer.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've spoken with Grimshade?  What did he say?

...What?  The Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak?  That's unbearable!  We must organize a force to get him back!

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 45 to 51, 26,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Witherbark Cages
quests.objectiveText: Check the cages at the two Witherbark villages, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

quests.name: The Altar of Zul
quests.objectiveText: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

quests.name: Thadius Grimshade
quests.objectiveText: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: Nekrum's Medallion
quests.objectiveText: Bring Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: The Divination
quests.objectiveText: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.

quests.name: Saving Sharpbeak
quests.objectiveText: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.
